snippet.title: False Hero - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure with a unique ability system, imaginative setting and gripping soundtrack.

In a realm where gods create life, Death starts to spread. You are the last hope in destroying the evil the gods have brought upon themselves. Will you side with Life or fight for Death itself?

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538870
